name: Bluetooth Classic discoverable (kitsune)
description: A kitsune fox that is a discoverable Bluetooth Classic device with a name and a spoofed address. Original-ESP32 boards only. Configuration is compiled into the firmware from a conference header; this page prepares, checks and exports that header (docs/kitsune-integration-plan.md). kitsune belongs to its authors: https://github.com/rfhs/kitsune
